methods.label: Bisected angles and the triangle angle sum
methods.explanation: Since \(AB\parallel CD\), \(\angle AEF+\angle EFD=180^\circ\). The two angle bisectors give \(\angle GEF+\angle GFE=90^\circ\), so \(\angle G=180^\circ-90^\circ=90^\circ\).
